shortDescription: NetApp Cloud Manager CVO/working environment in single or HA mode for Azure.

options.name: allow_deploy_in_existing_rg
options.description: Indicates if to allow creation in existing resource group.

options.name: availability_zone
options.description: The availability zone on the location configuration.

options.name: availability_zone_node1
options.description: The node1 availability zone on the location configuration for HA.

options.name: availability_zone_node2
options.description: The node2 availability zone on the location configuration for HA.

options.name: azure_encryption_parameters
options.description: AZURE encryption parameters. It is required if using AZURE encryption.

options.name: azure_tag
options.description: Additional tags for the AZURE CVO working environment.

options.name: backup_volumes_to_cbs
options.description: Automatically enable back up of all volumes to S3.

options.name: capacity_package_name
options.description: Capacity package name is required when selecting a capacity based license. Essential only available with Bring Your Own License Capacity-Based. Professional available as an annual contract from a cloud provider or Bring Your Own License Capacity-Based.

options.name: capacity_tier
options.description: Whether to enable data tiering for the first data aggregate.

options.name: cidr
options.description: The CIDR of the VNET. If not provided, resource needs az login to authorize and fetch the cidr details from Azure.

options.name: client_id
options.description: The connector ID of the Cloud Manager Connector. You can find the ID from the Connector tab on [https://cloudmanager.netapp.com].

options.name: cloud_provider_account
options.description: The cloud provider credentials id to use when deploying the Cloud Volumes ONTAP system. You can find the ID in Cloud Manager from the Settings > Credentials page. If not specified, Cloud Manager uses the instance profile of the Connector.

options.name: data_encryption_type
options.description: The type of encryption to use for the working environment.

options.name: disk_size
options.description: Azure volume size for the first data aggregate. For GB, the value can be [100, 500]. For TB, the value can be [1,2,4,8,16].

options.name: disk_size_unit
options.description: The unit for disk size.

options.name: enable_compliance
options.description: Enable the Cloud Compliance service on the working environment.

options.name: enable_monitoring
options.description: Enable the Monitoring service on the working environment.

options.name: environment
options.description: The environment for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: feature_flags
options.description: Enable or disable a new feature. This can be used to enable an experimental feature or disable a new feature that breaks backward compatibility. Supported keys and values are subject to change without notice.  Unknown keys are ignored.

options.name: ha_enable_https
options.description: For HA, enable the HTTPS connection from CVO to storage accounts. This can impact write performance. The default is false.

options.name: instance_type
options.description: The type of instance to use, which depends on the license type you chose. Explore ['Standard_DS3_v2']. Standard ['Standard_DS4_v2, Standard_DS13_v2, Standard_L8s_v2']. Premium ['Standard_DS5_v2', 'Standard_DS14_v2']. For more supported instance types, refer to Cloud Volumes ONTAP Release Notes.

options.name: is_ha
options.description: Indicate whether the working environment is an HA pair or not.

options.name: license_type
options.description: The type of license to use. For single node by Capacity ['capacity-paygo']. For single node by Node paygo ['azure-cot-explore-paygo', 'azure-cot-standard-paygo', 'azure-cot-premium-paygo']. For single node by Node byol ['azure-cot-premium-byol']. For HA by Capacity ['ha-capacity-paygo']. For HA by Node paygo ['azure-ha-cot-standard-paygo', 'azure-ha-cot-premium-paygo']. For HA by Node byol ['azure-ha-cot-premium-byol'].

options.name: location
options.description: The location where the working environment will be created.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the Cloud Manager CVO for AZURE to manage.

options.name: nss_account
options.description: The NetApp Support Site account ID to use with this Cloud Volumes ONTAP system. If the license type is BYOL and an NSS account isn't provided, Cloud Manager tries to use the first existing NSS account.

options.name: ontap_version
options.description: The required ONTAP version. Ignored if 'use_latest_version' is set to true.

options.name: platform_serial_number_node1
options.description: For HA BYOL, the serial number for the first node.

options.name: platform_serial_number_node2
options.description: For HA BYOL, the serial number for the second node.

options.name: provided_license
options.description: Using a NLF license file for BYOL deployment.

options.name: refresh_token
options.description: The refresh token for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: resource_group
options.description: The resource_group where Cloud Volumes ONTAP will be created. If not provided, Cloud Manager generates the resource group name (name of the working environment/CVO with suffix '-rg'). If the resource group does not exist, it is created.

options.name: sa_client_id
options.description: The service account secret client ID for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: sa_secret_key
options.description: The service account secret key for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: security_group_id
options.description: The ID of the security group for the working environment. If not provided, Cloud Manager creates the security group.

options.name: serial_number
options.description: The serial number for the cluster. Required when using one of these, 'azure-cot-premium-byol' or 'azure-ha-cot-premium-byol'.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the specified Cloud Manager CVO for AZURE should exist or not.

options.name: storage_type
options.description: The type of storage for the first data aggregate.

options.name: subnet_id
options.description: The name of the subnet for the Cloud Volumes ONTAP system.

options.name: subscription_id
options.description: The ID of the Azure subscription.

options.name: svm_name
options.description: The name of the SVM.

options.name: svm_password
options.description: The admin password for Cloud Volumes ONTAP. It will be updated on each run.

options.name: tier_level
options.description: If capacity_tier is Blob, this argument indicates the tiering level.

options.name: update_svm_password
options.description: Indicates whether to update svm_password on the CVO. When set to true, the module is not idempotent, as we cannot read the current password.

options.name: upgrade_ontap_version
options.description: Indicates whether to upgrade ONTAP image on the CVO. If the current version already matches the desired version, no action is taken.

options.name: use_latest_version
options.description: Indicates whether to use the latest available ONTAP version.

options.name: vnet_id
options.description: The name of the virtual network.

options.name: vnet_resource_group
options.description: The resource group in Azure associated to the virtual network.

options.name: workspace_id
options.description: The ID of the Cloud Manager workspace where you want to deploy Cloud Volumes ONTAP. If not provided, Cloud Manager uses the first workspace. You can find the ID from the Workspace tab on [https://cloudmanager.netapp.com].

options.name: writing_speed_state
options.description: The write speed setting for Cloud Volumes ONTAP ['NORMAL','HIGH']. This argument is not relevant for HA pairs.
